preconditions.description: The length of the text string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the pattern string pat must be at least 1 and at most the length of S.
Both S and pat must be strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(map(str, result)) if result else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the 1-based indices of occurrences of pat in S, or -1 if no occurrences are found.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(S) for index in result)
postconditions.description: All returned indices must be valid 1-based indices within the bounds of S.

postconditions.expression: len(result) == sum(1 for i in range(len(S) - len(pat) + 1) if S[i:i+len(pat)] == pat)
postconditions.description: The number of returned indices must match the number of occurrences of pat in S.
